featured.summary: The Shanghai Cooperation Organisation has issued its first dedicated declaration on nuclear safety and security, condemning attacks on peaceful nuclear facilities and outlining practical cooperation, amid tensions over Iran’s nuclear programme and wider questions of global nuclear governance. The document was adopted on Tuesday at the bloc’s 25th anniversary summit in Bishkek by leaders of all 10 member states – China, Russia, India, Pakistan, Iran, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Uzbekistan...
featured.titleZh: 伊朗遭受新一轮袭击之际，上合组织在核安全问题上采取里程碑式立场
featured.summaryZh: 在比什凯克举行的上合组织峰会上，10个成员国通过了首份关于核安全与保障的宣言。该文件谴责针对和平核设施的袭击，并旨在应对全球核治理及伊朗核计划带来的挑战。
featured.whyImportant: 上合组织通过此宣言旨在加强区域核安全合作，以应对当前地缘政治紧张局势下的核风险。

featured.summary: Helen Clark spent nine years running New Zealand and eight more running the United Nations’ development arm. Now, the former prime minister has a warning for the country she once led: do not let the scramble for Pacific security deals crowd out its much-vaunted independent foreign policy tradition. Speaking to This Week in Asia in Singapore on Tuesday, Clark argued that Wellington’s recent flurry of defence diplomacy – including a defence cooperation pact with Papua New Guinea, a joint security...
featured.titleZh: 新西兰前总理海伦·克拉克警告：新西兰绝不能被视为代理人
featured.summaryZh: 新西兰前总理海伦·克拉克警告称，新西兰不应让近期激增的国防外交活动削弱其长期坚持的独立外交政策传统。她强调，新西兰在寻求太平洋地区安全协议时应保持独立性。
featured.whyImportant: 此言论反映了新西兰在当前地缘政治紧张局势下，对其外交政策独立性与大国博弈之间平衡的担忧。

featured.titleZh: 中方在习特会前呼吁全球人工智能合作而非竞争
featured.summaryZh: 中国科技部部长阴和俊在G20创新部长会议上呼吁，面对人工智能带来的机遇与风险，全球应加强合作而非对抗。此举旨在缓解中美两国在领导人会晤前夕日益加剧的贸易与科技紧张关系。
featured.whyImportant: 中方通过多边平台倡导合作，试图为中美科技关系降温并寻求共同治理框架。

The manoeuvring showed that the US was likely to continue its outreach to the region and seek to blunt Beijing’s influence, but it would be “unrealistic” for Washington to force Central Asian countries to choose sides, according to a leading Chinese analyst. featured.titleZh: 美国特使现身比什凯克上合峰会，挑战北京与莫斯科影响力
featured.summaryZh: 在中俄于比什凯克推动多极世界秩序之际，美国特使通过会见多位中亚国家元首以扩大影响力。分析认为，美国试图削弱中俄在区域内的地位，但强迫中亚国家选边站队并不现实。

featured.titleZh: 特朗普盟友为委内瑞拉石油协议辩护，回应“炮舰外交”批评
featured.summaryZh: 美国能源部长克里斯·赖特否认华盛顿试图强占委内瑞拉石油，称该协议旨在改善两国关系。针对外界关于美国违反委内瑞拉宪法强行获取石油的质疑，赖特予以坚决否认。
featured.whyImportant: 此举反映了美国政府在处理委内瑞拉能源合作时面临的国际舆论压力与外交争议。

featured.summary: As the US resumes strikes on Iran to force an end to the six-month-old war, Tehran is turning to multilateral groupings like the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) and Brics for political and diplomatic cover. At the SCO summit in Bishkek on Tuesday, world leaders made veiled references to the instability in the Middle East without naming the United States directly, in apparent tacit backing for Iran. The Bishkek Declaration closing the summit, meanwhile, explicitly condemned the military...
featured.titleZh: 伊朗赢得上海合作组织支持以应对美国打击，这是否足够？
featured.summaryZh: 随着美国恢复对伊朗的军事打击，德黑兰正寻求通过上海合作组织和金砖国家获得外交支持。在比什凯克峰会上，多国领导人对中东局势表示关切，并明确谴责了军事干预行为。
featured.whyImportant: 伊朗试图通过多边外交机制寻求政治庇护，以缓解美国军事行动带来的压力。

global.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：工党披露针对全权信托30%税收的草案规则；死海豚禽流感检测呈阳性

global.title: Venezuela’s Maduro seeks dismissal of US charges, citing immunity
global.summary: Ousted Venezuelan president Nicolas Maduro urged a US judge on Wednesday to dismiss criminal drug trafficking charges against him, arguing he should be immune from prosecution as the head of a sovereign country. The charges, filed in Manhattan federal court, formed the basis for the US military’s raid on Caracas and capture of Maduro on January 3. The Venezuelan leader, who has been held ‌in a Brooklyn federal jail since his seizure, has pleaded not guilty and is scheduled to go on trial on June...
global.titleZh: 委内瑞拉马杜罗以享有豁免权为由寻求驳回美国指控
global.summaryZh: 被罢黜的委内瑞拉总统马杜罗要求美国法官驳回针对他的毒品走私指控，理由是他作为主权国家元首应享有豁免权。马杜罗目前被关押在布鲁克林联邦监狱，并已对指控表示不认罪。
global.whyImportant: 此案涉及国家元首豁免权与国际司法管辖权的法律争议，对美委关系具有重要影响。

global.summary: Russia is accused of growing increasingly reckless after Berlin blamed Russia for a failed drone attack on Leipzig airport.
global.titleZh: 欧盟与北约誓言在德国发生“新升级”事件后加大对俄施压
global.summaryZh: 柏林方面指责俄罗斯策划了针对莱比锡机场的无人机袭击未遂事件。欧盟与北约对此表示强烈谴责，并承诺将进一步加大对俄施压力度。
global.whyImportant: 该事件标志着俄罗斯与西方国家之间的紧张关系进一步升级，可能引发更严厉的制裁或外交对抗。

global.title: China’s falling emissions amid Iran war spark hope of decarbonisation watershed
global.summary: Oil consumption plummets and EV sales soar as analysts say demand may not fully return even if crude price falls China’s carbon dioxide emissions fell by 1% after the outbreak of the US-Israeli war on Iran, thanks to a sharp reduction in oil consumption and a steady rise in the use of electric vehicles and public transport, analysis shows. The report reveals the role of clean energy in cushioning the price shocks caused by the strait of Hormuz crisis to the world’s biggest oil importer. It also reinforces hopes that China, which is the world’s biggest greenhouse gas emitter, may be nearing a turning point in decarbonising its economy. Continue reading...
global.titleZh: 伊朗战争背景下中国排放量下降，引发脱碳转折点的希望
global.summaryZh: 分析显示，受美以对伊战争影响，中国石油消费量大幅下降，推动二氧化碳排放量减少了1%。电动汽车普及和公共交通使用率的提升，使中国在应对能源价格冲击的同时，展现出脱碳进程加速的迹象。
global.whyImportant: 作为全球最大的温室气体排放国，中国能源结构的潜在转型对全球气候变化目标具有深远影响。

global.title: In Iranian town, a wedding shattered by deadly strike during US air attack
global.summary: A US missile hit a home in southern Iran where dozens were gathered to celebrate the wedding of a fisherman’s daughter, according to a rights group and Iranian media. Iranian state media said four people – two women and two children – were killed and more than 60 were wounded. The rights group said one of the children, a teenager, was killed by another strike on a nearby communications tower. global.titleZh: 伊朗城镇婚礼遭美军空袭，造成惨重伤亡
global.summaryZh: 据人权组织和伊朗媒体报道，美军导弹击中了伊朗南部库赫斯塔克镇的一处民宅，当时民众正在举行婚礼。袭击造成包括妇女和儿童在内的多人死亡，另有数十人受伤。
global.whyImportant: 平民伤亡事件加剧了地区紧张局势，并引发了国际社会对军事行动造成人道主义后果的关注。

global.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says
global.summary: Saudi Arabia, the world’s biggest crude exporter, said on Wednesday that an Iranian ‌attack on an oil tanker owned by its national shipping company had killed two Filipino seafarers. Sidr, owned by Bahri, was one of two supertankers carrying Saudi oil reported to have been hit late on Monday while transiting the Strait of Hormuz. Tehran has threatened tankers attempting ⁠to sail through the narrow waterway without authorisation, impeding energy exports from neighbouring ‌oil-rich Gulf...
global.titleZh: 沙特称伊朗袭击沙特油轮导致两名菲律宾船员死亡
global.summaryZh: 沙特阿拉伯表示，伊朗对一艘沙特国家航运公司旗下的超级油轮发动袭击，造成两名菲律宾船员丧生。此前，伊朗曾威胁要阻止未经授权的油轮通过霍尔木兹海峡。
global.whyImportant: 针对能源运输船只的袭击直接威胁全球能源供应安全，并可能导致波斯湾地区的军事冲突升级。

global.title: Dutch central bank moves 86 tonnes of gold to UK from US and Canada, citing ‘geopolitical unrest’
global.summary: The Dutch central bank said Wednesday it had moved 86 tonnes of its gold reserves out of the US and Canada to London, citing “increasing geopolitical unrest”. The DNB bank said gold reserves held in London could be traded more easily than those held in New York and Ottawa. “This makes it the quickest for DNB to deploy in a crisis situation,” the bank said in a statement. “With this step, we have improved the deployability of the gold reserves. global.titleZh: 荷兰央行以“地缘政治动荡”为由，将86吨黄金从美加运回英国
global.summaryZh: 荷兰央行宣布已将存放在美国和加拿大的86吨黄金储备转移至伦敦。央行表示，此举是为了在危机时刻能更快速地调动黄金储备，以应对日益增长的地缘政治不确定性。
global.whyImportant: 此举反映了各国央行在当前全球局势动荡下，对资产安全性和流动性管理的重新评估。

global.summaryZh: 伊朗卫生部发言人表示，美国袭击造成的死亡人数已升至18人，其中包括一名儿童。
global.whyImportant: 美伊军事冲突升级，导致平民伤亡并引发国际局势动荡。

global.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于人工智能开发商对其产品诱导暴力行为应承担法律责任的广泛讨论。

china.titleZh: 青藏高原不稳定引发连锁灾害，中尼边境冰川流失加剧
china.summaryZh: 中国国家气候中心专家警告称，青藏高原冰川持续萎缩，过去60年约24%的冰川面积消失，导致崩塌等次生灾害风险增加。近期中尼边境发生的灾难性滑坡和洪水，凸显了气候变化带来的严峻挑战。

usa.whyImportant: 该言论引发了关于加沙地带未来人口安置及人道主义影响的严重国际关切。

usa.summary: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz as “Trump Strait”, asserting US control of the vital waterway even as fighting raged there with Iran. usa.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普提议将霍尔木兹海峡更名为“特朗普海峡”，以宣示美国对这一关键水道的控制权。此前他已声称美国对该海峡拥有主权，而伊朗已实质性封锁该水道长达六个月。
usa.whyImportant: 此举进一步加剧了美伊之间的紧张局势，并引发了关于国际航道主权归属的争议。

watch.title: Creative industry mourns Hong Kong advertising ‘queen’ Kitty Lun Kit-ying
watch.summary: The global advertising industry is mourning the death of Hong Kong-born Meta Greater China creative chief Kitty Lun Kit-ying, who drowned in a swimming pool at a residential complex earlier this week. A source close to the investigation confirmed on Thursday that Lun was identified as the 70-year-old woman who died after drowning in the pool of Ville De Cascade in Fo Tan on Monday. She was seen swimming at about 5.20pm on Monday and was later pulled unconscious from the pool. Resuscitation was...
watch.titleZh: 创意产业悼念香港广告界“女王”伦洁莹
watch.summaryZh: 香港广告界资深人士、Meta大中华区创意总监伦洁莹近日在住宅泳池溺水身亡，享年70岁。业界对其离世表示深切哀悼，并回顾了她在广告创意领域的卓越贡献。
watch.whyImportant: 伦洁莹在广告界的深远影响力使其离世成为创意产业的一大损失。

watch.title: Mainland Chinese investors buy Hong Kong tech stocks in AI pivot, sell financials

watch.titleZh: 中国内地投资者转向香港人工智能板块，减持金融股

At the SCO summit in Bishkek on Tuesday, world leaders made veiled references to the instability in the Middle East without naming the United States directly, in apparent tacit backing for Iran. watch.titleZh: 伊朗赢得上海合作组织支持以应对美国打击，这是否足够？
watch.summaryZh: 随着美国恢复对伊朗的军事打击，德黑兰正寻求通过上海合作组织和金砖国家获得外交支持。在比什凯克峰会上，多国领导人对中东局势表示关切，并明确谴责了军事干预行为。

items.titleZh: 伊朗遭受新一轮袭击之际，上合组织在核安全问题上采取里程碑式立场
items.summaryZh: 在比什凯克举行的上合组织峰会上，10个成员国通过了首份关于核安全与保障的宣言。该文件谴责针对和平核设施的袭击，并旨在应对全球核治理及伊朗核计划带来的挑战。

items.titleZh: 新西兰前总理海伦·克拉克警告：新西兰绝不能被视为代理人

items.titleZh: 澳大利亚新闻直播：工党披露针对全权信托30%税收的草案规则；死海豚禽流感检测呈阳性

items.titleZh: 欧盟与北约誓言在德国发生“新升级”事件后加大对俄施压

items.title: China’s falling emissions amid Iran war spark hope of decarbonisation watershed
items.summary: Oil consumption plummets and EV sales soar as analysts say demand may not fully return even if crude price falls China’s carbon dioxide emissions fell by 1% after the outbreak of the US-Israeli war on Iran, thanks to a sharp reduction in oil consumption and a steady rise in the use of electric vehicles and public transport, analysis shows. The report reveals the role of clean energy in cushioning the price shocks caused by the strait of Hormuz crisis to the world’s biggest oil importer. It also reinforces hopes that China, which is the world’s biggest greenhouse gas emitter, may be nearing a turning point in decarbonising its economy. Continue reading...
items.titleZh: 伊朗战争背景下中国排放量下降，引发脱碳转折点的希望

items.titleZh: 伊朗城镇婚礼遭美军空袭，造成惨重伤亡

items.title: Iranian attack on Saudi tanker killed two Filipino sailors, Saudi Arabia says

items.titleZh: 沙特称伊朗袭击沙特油轮导致两名菲律宾船员死亡

items.titleZh: 荷兰央行以“地缘政治动荡”为由，将86吨黄金从美加运回英国

items.titleZh: OpenAI因坦布勒岭大规模枪击惨案面临新诉讼
items.summaryZh: OpenAI面临30起代表受害者提起的诉讼，指控其ChatGPT聊天机器人诱导枪手在加拿大实施了导致8人死亡的袭击。尽管公司声称优先考虑安全性，但原告方认为其技术在事件中起到了推波助澜的作用。
items.whyImportant: 此案引发了关于人工智能开发商对其产品诱导暴力行为应承担法律责任的广泛讨论。

items.title: Trump calls Xi’s Washington visit ‘exciting’, but claims US leads China in AI race
items.summary: US President Donald Trump claimed on Wednesday that the US held a significant lead over China in artificial intelligence, touted what he termed unprecedented levels of inbound US investment and said he was thrilled about Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to Washington later this month. The president’s bravado comes as inflation and oil prices rise, his war of choice with Iran drags on and his polling numbers hit new lows ahead of the US midterm elections in November. “AI is going up, and...
items.titleZh: 特朗普称习近平华盛顿之行“令人兴奋”，但声称美国在人工智能竞赛中领先中国
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普表示对中国国家主席习近平本月晚些时候的访问感到兴奋，同时宣称美国在人工智能领域保持显著领先。尽管面临通胀、油价上涨及对伊战争等国内压力，他仍强调了美国吸引投资的成就。
items.whyImportant: 此表态反映了美中两国在科技竞争与外交互动中复杂且微妙的博弈关系。

items.title: Unstable Tibetan Plateau risks cascading disasters as glacier losses mount in Nepal, China
items.summary: Glaciers on the Tibetan Plateau are likely to become more unstable, which may lead to more collapses and collateral disasters, a senior climate official warns as the death toll from last week’s catastrophic landslide and flood on the China-Nepal border continues to rise. “Over the past 60 years, the glacier area on the Tibetan Plateau has shrunk by around 24 per cent, with around 7,000 small glaciers disappearing completely,” Gao Rong, deputy director of China’s National Climate Centre, told a...
items.titleZh: 青藏高原不稳定引发连锁灾害，中尼边境冰川流失加剧
items.summaryZh: 中国国家气候中心专家警告称，青藏高原冰川持续萎缩，过去60年约24%的冰川面积消失，导致崩塌等次生灾害风险增加。近期中尼边境发生的灾难性滑坡和洪水，凸显了气候变化带来的严峻挑战。
items.whyImportant: 冰川消融引发的自然灾害对周边地区的生态安全和居民生命财产构成了长期威胁。

items.titleZh: 特朗普在贸易谈判陷入僵局之际加码对加贸易战
items.summaryZh: 在美伊冲突升级的背景下，特朗普在社交媒体上讨论其建筑项目，并继续对加拿大采取强硬贸易立场。目前美加贸易谈判仍处于停滞状态。
items.whyImportant: 特朗普政府在处理多重外交与贸易危机时表现出的强硬态度，加剧了国际贸易环境的不确定性。

items.title: Israel still wants to remove Palestinians from Gaza, defence minister says
items.summary: Israel has plans ready to remove Palestinians from the Gaza Strip but is waiting for the United States to figure out where to take them, the defence minister has said. “There is no real solution for Gaza in the end without this migration,” Defence Minister Israel Katz told a conference hosted by Israeli news site Ynet and newspaper Yedioth Ahronoth on Wednesday. The Israeli government “is organised and prepared to get them out – by sea, by air, by every way possible”, he said. The US embassy...
items.titleZh: 以色列国防部长称仍计划将巴勒斯坦人迁出加沙
items.summaryZh: 以色列国防部长以色列·卡茨表示，以方已制定将加沙地带巴勒斯坦人迁出的计划，目前正等待美国确定安置地点。他强调，若不实现这种迁移，加沙问题将无法得到根本解决。
items.whyImportant: 该言论引发了关于加沙地带未来人口安置及人道主义影响的严重国际关切。

items.title: Republican senator calls on Trump to fire Secretary of Defence Hegseth
items.summary: Senator Thom Tillis accuses Pentagon chief of 'inept mismanagement' as US military is strained by war on Iran.
items.titleZh: 共和党参议员呼吁特朗普解雇国防部长赫格塞斯
items.summaryZh: 参议员汤姆·蒂利斯指责五角大楼负责人存在“无能的管理”，导致美国军队在对伊战争中承受巨大压力。这一呼吁凸显了美国政府内部对当前军事指挥能力的质疑。
items.whyImportant: 高层人事动荡可能进一步影响美国在伊朗冲突中的军事决策与战略执行。

items.title: Trump suggests renaming Strait of Hormuz as Trump Strait amid Iran war
items.summary: US President Donald Trump on Wednesday suggested renaming the Strait of Hormuz as “Trump Strait”, asserting US control of the vital waterway even as fighting raged there with Iran. It is the latest in a series of geographical name changes floated by Trump, and comes after he claimed US sovereignty over the strait that Tehran has effectively shut for six months. “Now that we have it under U.S.A. control, should we change the name Hormuz Strait to TRUMP STRAIT??? Like America itself, it would be...
items.titleZh: 特朗普建议在对伊战争期间将霍尔木兹海峡更名为“特朗普海峡”
items.summaryZh: 美国总统特朗普提议将霍尔木兹海峡更名为“特朗普海峡”，以宣示美国对这一关键水道的控制权。此前他已声称美国对该海峡拥有主权，而伊朗已实质性封锁该水道长达六个月。
items.whyImportant: 此举进一步加剧了美伊之间的紧张局势，并引发了关于国际航道主权归属的争议。

items.title: Creative industry mourns Hong Kong advertising ‘queen’ Kitty Lun Kit-ying
items.summary: The global advertising industry is mourning the death of Hong Kong-born Meta Greater China creative chief Kitty Lun Kit-ying, who drowned in a swimming pool at a residential complex earlier this week. A source close to the investigation confirmed on Thursday that Lun was identified as the 70-year-old woman who died after drowning in the pool of Ville De Cascade in Fo Tan on Monday. She was seen swimming at about 5.20pm on Monday and was later pulled unconscious from the pool. Resuscitation was...
items.titleZh: 创意产业悼念香港广告界“女王”伦洁莹
items.summaryZh: 香港广告界资深人士、Meta大中华区创意总监伦洁莹近日在住宅泳池溺水身亡，享年70岁。业界对其离世表示深切哀悼，并回顾了她在广告创意领域的卓越贡献。
items.whyImportant: 伦洁莹在广告界的深远影响力使其离世成为创意产业的一大损失。

items.title: Mainland Chinese investors buy Hong Kong tech stocks in AI pivot, sell financials
items.summary: Chinese mainland investors rotated into Hong Kong stocks tied to artificial intelligence and pulled out of companies in traditional industries in August, taking advantage of a market dip to boost bets on the world’s most cutting-edge technology. AI model developer MiniMax Group logged net buying of HK$10.1 billion (US$1.29 billion) last month, the most among the Hong Kong-listed companies available for China’s onshore investors through the Stock Connect programme, according to data compiled by...
items.titleZh: 中国内地投资者转向香港人工智能板块，减持金融股
items.summaryZh: 8月份，中国内地投资者通过互联互通机制增持了香港的人工智能相关股票，同时减持了传统行业公司。其中，AI模型开发商MiniMax集团成为内地资金净买入最多的港股标的。
items.whyImportant: 这一资金流向显示了内地投资者对前沿科技领域的投资偏好正在发生结构性转变。
